# Navajit D

> AI Product Manager at Pine Labs (Bengaluru). Engineer-turned-PM shipping production AI agents — voice, email, and multimodal chat — with measurable ROI over hype. Also writes essays and builds side projects.

## Pages
- [Home](https://navajitd.github.io/): Profile, experience, and contact.
- [Projects](https://navajitd.github.io/projects.html): Personal builds — Mrs Font, ArchiHelp, Will you?, Numo, Aria, ProbashiBangalore, MyExpenses, HealThee, Letter Hunt, and Vidur.
- [Blog](https://navajitd.github.io/blog.html): Essays on building AI products and personal projects.
- [Recipes](https://navajitd.github.io/recipes.html): Field notes from the kitchen.

## Projects
- [Mrs Font](https://mrsfont.web.app): Free font identifier and browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) — names the font on any web page, screenshot, PDF or font file, including the one the browser actually rendered, with free look-alikes first; plus a font pairing generator scored on Ellen Lupton's type classification and whole-site font scans.
- [ArchiHelp](https://navajitd.github.io/Projects/ArchiHelp/planner.html): Free parametric floor-plan designer in three tabs. Projects; Floor plan — guided setup, multi-core layout search scored on 32-pada Vaastu rules, NBC room sizes and a structural grid, one tab per floor with the staircase kept in line, an editor for walls, doors, windows and furniture, and a dimensioned A3 drawing set (PDF); Wind circulation — the house on its site (latitude/longitude, neighbours, floor heights, ceiling fans) simulated through a typical day of each season or chosen dates with Open-Meteo weather: airflow and room temperatures per floor, in plan and in a cut-away section. Existing plans can be traced from a photo, scan or PDF. No sign-in; runs entirely in the browser.
- [Will you?](https://willyou.web.app): Pixel-art page generator for popping a question — customisable escalating messages, theme, and sticker, with a confetti celebration at the end. Firebase, Cloud Functions.
- [Numo](https://numo.web.app): AI numerology guide answering life queries, built with Mystics Mentor.
- [Aria](https://talktoaria.web.app): AI voice sales agent that phones you and roleplays a Hinglish post-demo-class sales call — intent classification, objection handling, and next-step decisions shown in real time. Pipecat, Deepgram Nova-3, Sarvam Bulbul v3, Cloud Run.
- [ProbashiBangalore](https://probashibangalore.web.app): Editorial guide for Bengalis making a home in Bengaluru — food, festivals, communities, and everyday essentials; currently gathering readers via waitlist.
- [MyExpenses](https://navajitd.github.io/Projects/MyExpenses/expenses.html): Free AI expense tracker with automated categorization, budget tracking, and spending-pattern insights.
- [HealThee](https://navajitd.github.io/Projects/HealThee/health.html): Free AI health tracker (HealthifyMe Plus alternative) — calorie/macro/micronutrient tracking, adaptive meal plans, exercise, sleep, and trend dashboards; installable PWA.
- [Letter Hunt](https://navajitd.github.io/Projects/Sketches/letter-hunt.html): Free p5.js browser game — find letters hidden in Bengaluru street photography.
- [Vidur](https://navajitd.github.io/projects.html#vidur): Free, open-source browser extension (Chrome/Edge/Brave/Firefox) that visually redesigns any website with AI while leaving content intact; bring-your-own-key, designs persist across visits.
